description_short: Toolbar HUD Customization-suite for the entire bottom side UI. Buttons drag & drop reordering, coloring, custom sections, profiles ..and more!
description_long: Toolbar Editor provides a complete visual editor for the Captain of Industry toolbar. Its six middle default sections are fixed Toolbar Editor-owned mirrors that can be renamed or switched between horizontal rows and vertical rails while preserving the original live buttons, actions, unlocks, and gameplay behavior.
